questions.solution_html:
• Image sampling ((1 mark)): Sampling converts the continuous spatial coordinates of an image into a
  • finite set of discrete pixel locations. Image quantization ((1 mark)): Quantization converts the
  • continuous intensity values of the sampled image into a finite number of discrete intensity or gray
  • levels.
